classes.label: GST 5% (restaurant service, no input tax credit)
classes.applies_to: Restaurant service, including takeaway and own delivery, outside specified premises

classes.label: GST 18% (restaurant in specified premises, with input tax credit)
classes.applies_to: Restaurant service in specified premises (hotel premises above the notified room-tariff threshold)

classes.label: Nil-rated / exempt goods
classes.applies_to: Shop items with no GST (e.g. unpackaged fresh produce)
_unverified: Which goods are nil-rated or exempt was not researched; the class exists so a shop can mark items

classes.label: GST 5% (goods)
classes.applies_to: Shop items in the 5% slab, chosen per item

classes.label: GST 12% (goods)
classes.applies_to: Shop items in the 12% slab, chosen per item
_unverified: The September 2025 GST rate rationalisation was reported to fold most 12% goods into 5% or 18%; whether a 12% goods slab still applies to any item was not verified. Kept as data so an item can carry it if it does

classes.label: GST 18% (goods)
classes.applies_to: Shop items in the 18% slab, chosen per item

_unverified: price_display "exclusive" (GST added on the bill) is common restaurant practice, not a sourced rule; packaged goods carry an MRP that is tax-inclusive
Intra-state CGST+SGST split only; IGST for inter-state supply is not modelled
Per-item goods slabs are data chosen by the merchant; the pack does not map HSN codes to slabs

tax_ids.label: GSTIN
_unverified: GST registration turnover thresholds are not modelled; the pack assumes a registered business

invoice.title: Tax Invoice
_unverified: Exact GST invoice field list (e.g. SAC code, place of supply) not re-read against the CGST Rules
Buyer details threshold for B2C invoices not modelled

printed_price.applies_to: Packaged goods sold by a shop that carry a printed MRP (maximum retail price, inclusive of all taxes)
_unverified: The MRP rule follows the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules as commonly applied; exceptions (e.g. restaurant service of packaged drinks) were not researched

aggregators.legal_basis: CGST Act Sec 9(5): GST on restaurant service supplied through an electronic commerce operator is paid by the operator
